summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:4

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:4

text.en: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak—not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:5

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:5

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:5

text.en: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:6

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:6

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:6

text.en: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:7

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:7

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:7

text.en: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:8

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:8

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:8

text.en: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:9

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:9

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:9

text.en: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:10

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:10

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:10

text.en: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:11

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:11

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:11

text.en: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:12

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:12

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:12

text.en: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:13

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:13

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:13

text.en: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:14

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:14

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:14

text.en: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:15

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:15

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:15

text.en: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:16

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:16

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:16

text.en: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:17

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:17

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:17

text.en: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:18

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:18

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:18

text.en: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:19

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:19

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:19

text.en: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:20

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:20

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:20

text.en: For you are our glory and our joy.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:1

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:1

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:1

text.en: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:2

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:2

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:2

text.en: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:3

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:3

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:3

text.en: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:4

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:4

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:4

text.en: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:5

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:5

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:5

text.en: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:6

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:6

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:6

text.en: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:7

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:7

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:7

text.en: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:8

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:8

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:8

text.en: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:9

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:9

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:9

text.en: For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:10

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:10

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:10

text.en: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:11

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:11

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:11

text.en: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:12

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:12

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:12

text.en: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:13

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:13

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 3:13

text.en: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:1

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:1

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:1

text.en: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:2

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:2

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:2

text.en: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:3

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:3

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:3

text.en: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:4

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:4

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:4

text.en: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:5

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:5

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:5

text.en: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:6

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:6

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:6

text.en: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:7

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:7

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:7

text.en: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:8

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:8

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:8

text.en: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:9

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:9

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:9

text.en: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:10

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:10

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:10

text.en: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:11

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:11

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:11

text.en: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:12

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:12

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 4:12

text.en: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:1

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:1

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:1

text.en: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:2

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:2

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:2

text.en: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:3

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:3

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:3

text.en: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:4

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:4

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:4

text.en: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:5

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:5

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:5

text.en: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:6

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:6

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:6

text.en: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:7

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:7

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:7

text.en: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:8

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:8

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:8

text.en: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:9

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:9

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:9

text.en: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:10

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:10

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:10

text.en: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:11

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:11

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:11

text.en: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:12

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:12

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:12

text.en: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:13

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:13

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:13

text.en: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:24

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:24

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:24

text.en: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:25

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:25

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:25

text.en: Brothers, pray for us.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:26

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:26

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:26

text.en: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:27

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:27

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:27

text.en: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:28

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:28

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to the Thessalonians 5:28

text.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:1

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:1

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:1

text.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ our hope,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:2

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:2

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:2

text.en: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:3

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:3

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:3

text.en: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:4

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:4

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:4

text.en: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:5

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:5

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:5

text.en: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:6

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:6

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:6

text.en: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:7

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:7

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:7

text.en: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say nor about what they strongly affirm.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:8

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:8

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:8

text.en: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:9

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:9

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:9

text.en: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:10

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:10

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:10

text.en: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:11

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:11

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:11

text.en: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:12

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:12

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:12

text.en: I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:13

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:13

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:13

text.en: although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:14

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:14

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:14

text.en: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:18

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:18

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:18

text.en: I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:19

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:19

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:19

text.en: holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:20

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:20

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 1:20

text.en: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:8

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:8

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:8

text.en: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:9

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:9

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:9

text.en: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:10

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:10

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:10

text.en: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:11

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:11

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:11

text.en: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:12

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:12

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:12

text.en: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:13

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:13

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:13

text.en: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:14

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:14

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:14

text.en: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:15

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:15

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 2:15

text.en: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:1

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:1

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:1

text.en: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:2

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:2

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:2

text.en: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:3

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:3

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:3

text.en: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:4

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:4

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:4

text.en: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:5

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:5

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:5

text.en: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:6

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:6

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:6

text.en: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:7

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:7

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:7

text.en: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:8

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:8

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:8

text.en: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:9

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:9

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:9

text.en: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:10

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:10

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:10

text.en: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:11

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:11

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:11

text.en: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:12

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:12

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:12

text.en: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:13

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:13

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 3:13

text.en: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 4:4

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 4:4

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 4:4

text.en: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 4:5

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 4:5

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 4:5

text.en: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 4:6

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 4:6

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 4:6

text.en: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 4:7

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 4:7

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 4:7

text.en: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 4:8

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 4:8

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 4:8

text.en: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 4:16

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 4:16

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 4:16

text.en: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:1

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:1

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:1

text.en: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:2

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:2

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:2

text.en: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:3

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:3

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:3

text.en: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:4

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:4

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:4

text.en: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:5

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:5

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:5

text.en: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:6

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:6

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:6

text.en: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:7

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:7

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:7

text.en: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:8

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:8

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:8

text.en: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:9

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:9

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:9

text.en: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:10

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:10

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:10

text.en: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:11

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:11

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:11

text.en: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:12

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:12

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:12

text.en: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:13

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:13

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:13

text.en: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:14

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:14

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:14

text.en: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:15

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:15

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:15

text.en: For already some have turned away after Satan.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:16

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:16

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:16

text.en: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:17

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:17

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:17

text.en: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:18

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:18

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:18

text.en: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:19

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:19

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:19

text.en: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:20

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:20

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:20

text.en: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:21

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:21

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:21

text.en: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:22

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:22

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:22

text.en: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:23

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:23

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:23

text.en: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:24

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:24

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:24

text.en: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:25

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:25

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 5:25

text.en: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:1

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:1

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:1

text.en: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:2

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:2

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:2

text.en: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:3

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:3

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:3

text.en: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:4

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:4

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:4

text.en: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:5

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:5

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:5

text.en: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:6

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:6

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:6

text.en: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:7

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:7

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:7

text.en: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:8

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:8

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:8

text.en: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:9

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:9

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:9

text.en: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:10

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:10

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:10

text.en: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:11

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:11

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:11

text.en: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:17

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:17

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:17

text.en: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:18

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:18

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:18

text.en: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:19

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:19

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:19

text.en: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:20

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:20

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:20

text.en: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,

title.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:21

summary.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:21

speaker.en: Paul’s First Letter to Timothy 6:21

text.en: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:1

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:1

text.en: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:2

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:2

text.en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:3

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:3

text.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:4

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:4

text.en: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:5

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:5

text.en: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:6

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:6

text.en: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:7

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:7

text.en: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:8

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:8

text.en: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:9

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:9

text.en: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:10

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:10

text.en: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:11

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:11

text.en: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:12

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:12

text.en: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:13

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:13

text.en: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:14

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:14

text.en: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:15

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:15

text.en: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:16

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:16

text.en: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:17

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:17

text.en: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:18

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:18

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:18

text.en: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:19

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:19

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:19

text.en: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:20

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:20

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:20

text.en: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:21

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:21

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:21

text.en: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:22

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:22

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:22

text.en: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:23

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:23

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:23

text.en: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:24

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:24

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 1:24

text.en: We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:1

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:1

text.en: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:2

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:2

text.en: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:3

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:3

text.en: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:4

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:4

text.en: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:5

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:5

text.en: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:6

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:6

text.en: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:7

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:7

text.en: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:8

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:8

text.en: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:9

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:9

text.en: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:10

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:10

text.en: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:11

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:11

text.en: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:12

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:12

text.en: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:13

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:13

text.en: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:14

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:14

text.en: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:15

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:15

text.en: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who perish:

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:16

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:16

text.en: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:17

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 2:17

text.en: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:1

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:1

text.en: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:2

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:2

text.en: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:3

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:3

text.en: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:4

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:4

text.en: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:5

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:5

text.en: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:6

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:6

text.en: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:7

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:7

text.en: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:8

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:8

text.en: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:9

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:9

text.en: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:10

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:10

text.en: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:11

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:11

text.en: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:12

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:12

text.en: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:13

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:13

text.en: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:14

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:14

text.en: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:15

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:15

text.en: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:16

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:16

text.en: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:17

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:17

text.en: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:18

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:18

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 3:18

text.en: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:1

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:1

text.en: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:2

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:2

text.en: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:3

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:3

text.en: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:4

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:4

text.en: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:5

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:5

text.en: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:6

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:6

text.en: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:7

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:7

text.en: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:8

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:8

text.en: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:9

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:9

text.en: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:10

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:10

text.en: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:11

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:11

text.en: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:12

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:12

text.en: So then death works in us, but life in you.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:13

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:13

text.en: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore we also speak,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:14

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:14

text.en: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also through Jesus, and will present us with you.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:15

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:15

text.en: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:16

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:16

text.en: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:17

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:17

text.en: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:18

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:18

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 4:18

text.en: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:1

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:1

text.en: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:2

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:2

text.en: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:3

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:3

text.en: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:4

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:4

text.en: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:5

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:5

text.en: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:6

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:6

text.en: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:7

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:7

text.en: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:8

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:8

text.en: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:9

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:9

text.en: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:10

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:10

text.en: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:11

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:11

text.en: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:12

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:12

text.en: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:13

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:13

text.en: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:14

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:14

text.en: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:15

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:15

text.en: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:16

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:16

text.en: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:17

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:17

text.en: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:18

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:18

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:18

text.en: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:19

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:19

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:19

text.en: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:20

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:20

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:20

text.en: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:21

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:21

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 5:21

text.en: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:1

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:1

text.en: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:2

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:2

text.en: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:3

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:3

text.en: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:4

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:4

text.en: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:5

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:5

text.en: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:6

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:6

text.en: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:7

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:7

text.en: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:8

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:8

text.en: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:9

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:9

text.en: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:10

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:10

text.en: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:11

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:11

text.en: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:12

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:12

text.en: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:13

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:13

text.en: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:14

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:14

text.en: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:15

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:15

text.en: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:16

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 7:16

text.en: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:1

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:1

text.en: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:2

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:2

text.en: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:3

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:3

text.en: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:4

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:4

text.en: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:5

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:5

text.en: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:7

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:7

text.en: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:8

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:8

text.en: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:9

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:9

text.en: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:10

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:10

text.en: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:11

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:11

text.en: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:12

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:12

text.en: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:13

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:13

text.en: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:14

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:14

text.en: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:15

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:15

text.en: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.”

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:16

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:16

text.en: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:17

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:17

text.en: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:18

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:18

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:18

text.en: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.
