title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:19

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:19

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:19

text.en: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:20

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:20

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:20

text.en: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:21

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:21

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:21

text.en: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:22

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:22

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:22

text.en: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:23

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:23

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:23

text.en: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:24

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:24

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 8:24

text.en: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:1

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:1

text.en: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:2

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:2

text.en: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:3

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:3

text.en: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:4

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:4

text.en: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:5

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:5

text.en: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:12

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:12

text.en: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:13

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:13

text.en: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:14

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:14

text.en: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:15

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 9:15

text.en: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:1

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:1

text.en: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:2

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:2

text.en: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:3

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:3

text.en: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:4

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:4

text.en: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:5

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:5

text.en: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:6

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:6

text.en: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:7

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:7

text.en: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ’s, so we also are Christ’s.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:8

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:8

text.en: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:9

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:9

text.en: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:10

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:10

text.en: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:11

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:11

text.en: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:12

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:12

text.en: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:13

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:13

text.en: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:14

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:14

text.en: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:15

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:15

text.en: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:16

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:16

text.en: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:17

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:17

text.en: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:18

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:18

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 10:18

text.en: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:1

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:1

text.en: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:2

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:2

text.en: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:3

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:3

text.en: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:4

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:4

text.en: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:5

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:5

text.en: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:6

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:6

text.en: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:21

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:21

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:21

text.en: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:22

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:22

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:22

text.en: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:23

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:23

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:23

text.en: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:24

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:24

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:24

text.en: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:25

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:25

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:25

text.en: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:26

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:26

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:26

text.en: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:27

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:27

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:27

text.en: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:28

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:28

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:28

text.en: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:29

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:29

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:29

text.en: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:30

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:30

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:30

text.en: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:31

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:31

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:31

text.en: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:32

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:32

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:32

text.en: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:33

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:33

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 11:33

text.en: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:1

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:1

text.en: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:2

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:2

text.en: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:3

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:3

text.en: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:4

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:4

text.en: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:5

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:5

text.en: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:6

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:6

text.en: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:7

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:7

text.en: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:8

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:8

text.en: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:9

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:9

text.en: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:10

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:10

text.en: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:11

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:11

text.en: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:12

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:12

text.en: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:13

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:13

text.en: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:14

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:14

text.en: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:15

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:15

text.en: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:16

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:16

text.en: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:17

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:17

text.en: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:18

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:18

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:18

text.en: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:19

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:19

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:19

text.en: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:20

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:20

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:20

text.en: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:21

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:21

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 12:21

text.en: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:1

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:1

text.en: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:2

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:2

text.en: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:3

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:3

text.en: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:4

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:4

text.en: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:5

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:5

text.en: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:6

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:6

text.en: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:7

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:7

text.en: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:8

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:8

text.en: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:9

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:9

text.en: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:10

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:10

text.en: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:11

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:11

text.en: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:12

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:12

text.en: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:13

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:13

text.en: All the saints greet you.

title.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:14

summary.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians 13:14

text.en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.

title.en: Peter’s Second Letter 1:10

summary.en: Peter’s Second Letter 1:10

speaker.en: Peter’s Second Letter 1:10

text.en: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.

title.en: Peter’s Second Letter 1:11

summary.en: Peter’s Second Letter 1:11

speaker.en: Peter’s Second Letter 1:11

text.en: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

title.en: Peter’s Second Letter 1:12

summary.en: Peter’s Second Letter 1:12

speaker.en: Peter’s Second Letter 1:12

text.en: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.

title.en: Peter’s Second Letter 1:13

summary.en: Peter’s Second Letter 1:13

speaker.en: Peter’s Second Letter 1:13

text.en: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,

title.en: Peter’s Second Letter 1:14

summary.en: Peter’s Second Letter 1:14

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:9

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:9

text.en: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:10

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:10

text.en: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:11

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:11

text.en: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:12

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:12

text.en: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:13

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:13

text.en: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:14

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:14

text.en: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:15

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:15

text.en: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:16

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:16

text.en: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:17

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:17

text.en: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:18

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:18

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:18

text.en: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:19

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:19

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:19

text.en: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:20

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:20

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:20

text.en: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:21

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:21

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:21

text.en: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:22

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:22

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:22

text.en: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:23

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:23

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:23

text.en: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:24

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:24

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:24

text.en: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:25

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:25

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:25

text.en: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:26

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:26

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:26

text.en: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:27

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:27

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:27

text.en: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:28

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:28

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:28

text.en: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:29

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:29

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 1:29

text.en: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:1

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:1

text.en: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:2

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:2

text.en: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:3

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:3

text.en: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:4

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:4

text.en: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:5

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:5

text.en: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:6

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:6

text.en: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:7

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:7

text.en: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:13

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:13

text.en: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:14

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:14

text.en: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:15

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:15

text.en: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:16

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:16

text.en: Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:17

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:17

text.en: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:18

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:18

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:18

text.en: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:19

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:19

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:19

text.en: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:20

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:20

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:20

text.en: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:21

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:21

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:21

text.en: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:22

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:22

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:22

text.en: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:23

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:23

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 2:23

text.en: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body, but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:1

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:1

text.en: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:2

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:2

text.en: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:3

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:3

text.en: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:4

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:4

text.en: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:5

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:5

text.en: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:6

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:6

text.en: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:7

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:7

text.en: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:8

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:8

text.en: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:9

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:9

text.en: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:10

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:10

text.en: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:11

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:11

text.en: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:17

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:17

text.en: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:18

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:18

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:18

text.en: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:19

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:19

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:19

text.en: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:20

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:20

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:20

text.en: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:21

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:21

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:21

text.en: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:22

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:22

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:22

text.en: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:23

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:23

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:23

text.en: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:24

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:24

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:24

text.en: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:25

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:25

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 3:25

text.en: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:1

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:1

text.en: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:2

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:2

text.en: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:3

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:3

text.en: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:4

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:4

text.en: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:5

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:5

text.en: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:6

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:6

text.en: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:7

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:7

text.en: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:8

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:8

text.en: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:9

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:9

text.en: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:10

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:10

text.en: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:11

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:11

text.en: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:12

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:12

text.en: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:13

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:13

text.en: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:14

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:14

text.en: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:15

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:15

text.en: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:16

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:16

text.en: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:17

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:17

text.en: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:18

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:18

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Colossians 4:18

text.en: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:1

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:1

text.en: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:2

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:2

text.en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:3

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:3

text.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:4

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:4

text.en: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:5

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:5

text.en: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:6

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:6

text.en: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:7

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:7

text.en: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:8

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:8

text.en: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:9

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:9

text.en: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:10

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:10

text.en: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:11

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:11

text.en: We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:12

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:12

text.en: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:13

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:13

text.en: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:14

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:14

text.en: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:15

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:15

text.en: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:16

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:16

text.en: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 1:17

text.en: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:27

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:27

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:27

text.en: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:28

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:28

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:28

text.en: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:29

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:29

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:29

text.en: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:30

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:30

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:30

text.en: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:31

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:31

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:31

text.en: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:32

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:32

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:32

text.en: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:33

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:33

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 5:33

text.en: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:1

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:1

text.en: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:2

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:2

text.en: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:3

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:3

text.en: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:4

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:4

text.en: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:5

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:5

text.en: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:6

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:6

text.en: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:7

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:7

text.en: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:8

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:8

text.en: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:9

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:9

text.en: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:10

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:10

text.en: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:11

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:11

text.en: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:12

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:12

text.en: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:13

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:13

text.en: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:14

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:14

text.en: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:15

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:15

text.en: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:16

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:16

text.en: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:17

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:17

text.en: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:18

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:18

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:18

text.en: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:19

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:19

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:19

text.en: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:20

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:20

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:20

text.en: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:21

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:21

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:21

text.en: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:22

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:22

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:22

text.en: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:23

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:23

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:23

text.en: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:24

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:24

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Ephesians 6:24

text.en: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:1

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:1

text.en: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:2

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:2

text.en: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:3

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:3

text.en: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:4

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:4

text.en: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:5

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:5

text.en: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:6

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:6

text.en: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:7

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:7

text.en: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:8

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:8

text.en: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:9

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:9

text.en: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:10

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:10

text.en: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:11

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:11

text.en: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:12

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:12

text.en: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:13

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:13

text.en: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:14

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:14

text.en: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:15

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:15

text.en: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:16

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:16

text.en: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:17

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:17

text.en: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:18

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:18

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:18

text.en: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:19

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:19

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:19

text.en: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:20

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:20

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:20

text.en: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:21

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:21

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:21

text.en: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:22

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:22

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:22

text.en: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:23

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:23

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:23

text.en: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:24

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:24

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 1:24

text.en: So they glorified God in me.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:1

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:1

text.en: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:2

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:2

text.en: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:3

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:3

text.en: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:4

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:4

text.en: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:5

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:5

text.en: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:6

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:6

text.en: But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:7

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:7

text.en: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:8

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:8

text.en: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:9

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:9

text.en: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:10

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:10

text.en: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:11

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:11

text.en: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:12

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:12

text.en: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:13

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:13

text.en: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:14

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:14

text.en: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:15

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:15

text.en: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:16

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:16

text.en: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:17

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:17

text.en: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:18

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:18

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:18

text.en: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:19

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:19

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:19

text.en: For I through the law died to the law, that I might live to God.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:20

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:20

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:20

text.en: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:21

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:21

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 2:21

text.en: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:1

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:1

text.en: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:2

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:2

text.en: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:3

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:3

text.en: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:4

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:4

text.en: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:5

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:5

text.en: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:6

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:6

text.en: Even so, Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:7

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:7

text.en: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:8

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:8

text.en: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:9

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:9

text.en: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:10

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:10

text.en: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:11

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:11

text.en: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:12

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:12

text.en: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:15

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:15

text.en: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:16

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:16

text.en: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, which is Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:17

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:17

text.en: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:18

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:18

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Galatians 3:18
