summary.en: The Letter from James 1:8

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:8

text.en: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

title.en: The Letter from James 1:9

summary.en: The Letter from James 1:9

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:9

text.en: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

title.en: The Letter from James 1:10

summary.en: The Letter from James 1:10

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:10

text.en: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

title.en: The Letter from James 1:11

summary.en: The Letter from James 1:11

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:11

text.en: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.

title.en: The Letter from James 1:12

summary.en: The Letter from James 1:12

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:12

text.en: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.

title.en: The Letter from James 1:13

summary.en: The Letter from James 1:13

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:13

text.en: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

title.en: The Letter from James 1:14

summary.en: The Letter from James 1:14

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:14

text.en: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.

title.en: The Letter from James 1:15

summary.en: The Letter from James 1:15

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:15

text.en: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

title.en: The Letter from James 1:16

summary.en: The Letter from James 1:16

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:16

text.en: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.

title.en: The Letter from James 1:17

summary.en: The Letter from James 1:17

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:17

text.en: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.

title.en: The Letter from James 1:18

summary.en: The Letter from James 1:18

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:18

text.en: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

title.en: The Letter from James 1:19

summary.en: The Letter from James 1:19

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:19

text.en: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

title.en: The Letter from James 1:20

summary.en: The Letter from James 1:20

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:20

text.en: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

title.en: The Letter from James 1:21

summary.en: The Letter from James 1:21

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:21

text.en: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

title.en: The Letter from James 1:22

summary.en: The Letter from James 1:22

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:22

text.en: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

title.en: The Letter from James 1:23

summary.en: The Letter from James 1:23

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:23

text.en: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

title.en: The Letter from James 1:24

summary.en: The Letter from James 1:24

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:24

text.en: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

title.en: The Letter from James 1:25

summary.en: The Letter from James 1:25

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:25

text.en: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

title.en: The Letter from James 1:26

summary.en: The Letter from James 1:26

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:26

text.en: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.

title.en: The Letter from James 1:27

summary.en: The Letter from James 1:27

speaker.en: The Letter from James 1:27

text.en: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

title.en: The Good News According to John 3:13

summary.en: The Good News According to John 3:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 3:13

text.en: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

title.en: The Good News According to John 3:14

summary.en: The Good News According to John 3:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 3:14

text.en: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

title.en: The Good News According to John 3:15

summary.en: The Good News According to John 3:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 3:15

text.en: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

title.en: The Good News According to John 3:16

summary.en: The Good News According to John 3:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 3:16

text.en: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

title.en: The Good News According to John 3:17

summary.en: The Good News According to John 3:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 3:17

text.en: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

title.en: The Good News According to John 8:21

summary.en: The Good News According to John 8:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 8:21

text.en: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 8:22

summary.en: The Good News According to John 8:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 8:22

text.en: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”

title.en: The Good News According to John 8:23

summary.en: The Good News According to John 8:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 8:23

text.en: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

title.en: The Good News According to John 8:24

summary.en: The Good News According to John 8:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 8:24

text.en: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 8:25

summary.en: The Good News According to John 8:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 8:25

text.en: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.

title.en: The Good News According to John 8:26

summary.en: The Good News According to John 8:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 8:26

text.en: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 8:27

summary.en: The Good News According to John 8:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 8:27

text.en: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.

title.en: The Good News According to John 8:28

summary.en: The Good News According to John 8:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 8:28

text.en: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.

title.en: The Good News According to John 8:29

summary.en: The Good News According to John 8:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 8:29

text.en: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 8:30

summary.en: The Good News According to John 8:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 8:30

text.en: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:6

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:6

text.en: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:7

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:7

text.en: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:8

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:8

text.en: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:9

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:9

text.en: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:10

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:10

text.en: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:11

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:11

text.en: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:13

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:13

text.en: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:14

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:14

text.en: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:15

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:15

text.en: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:16

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:16

text.en: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:17

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:17

text.en: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:18

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:18

text.en: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:19

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:19

text.en: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:20

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:20

text.en: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:25

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:25

text.en: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:26

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:26

text.en: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:27

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:27

text.en: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:28

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:28

text.en: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:30

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:30

text.en: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:31

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:31

text.en: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:32

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:32

text.en: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:33

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:33

text.en: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:34

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:34

text.en: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.

title.en: The Good News According to John 19:35

summary.en: The Good News According to John 19:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 19:35

text.en: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:1

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:1

text.en: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:2

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:2

text.en: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:3

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:3

text.en: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:4

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:4

text.en: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:5

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:5

text.en: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:6

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:6

text.en: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:7

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:7

text.en: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:8

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:8

text.en: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:9

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:9

text.en: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:10

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:10

text.en: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:11

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:11

text.en: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:12

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:12

text.en: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:13

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:13

text.en: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:14

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:14

text.en: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:15

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:15

text.en: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:16

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:16

text.en: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:17

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:17

text.en: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:18

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:18

text.en: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:19

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:19

text.en: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:20

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:20

text.en: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:21

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:21

text.en: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:22

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:22

text.en: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:23

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:23

text.en: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:24

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:24

text.en: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:25

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:25

text.en: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:26

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:26

text.en: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:27

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:27

text.en: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:28

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:28

text.en: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:29

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:29

text.en: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:30

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:30

text.en: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

title.en: The Good News According to John 20:31

summary.en: The Good News According to John 20:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 20:31

text.en: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.

title.en: The Good News According to John 21:1

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:1

text.en: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

title.en: The Good News According to John 21:2

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:2

text.en: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

title.en: The Good News According to John 21:3

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:3

text.en: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.

title.en: The Good News According to John 21:4

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:4

text.en: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.

title.en: The Good News According to John 21:5

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:5

text.en: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 21:6

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:6

text.en: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

title.en: The Good News According to John 21:7

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:7

text.en: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.

title.en: The Good News According to John 21:8

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:8

text.en: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.

title.en: The Good News According to John 21:9

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:9

text.en: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.

title.en: The Good News According to John 21:10

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:10

text.en: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 21:11

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:11

text.en: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.

title.en: The Good News According to John 21:12

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:12

text.en: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.

title.en: The Good News According to John 21:13

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:15

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:16

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:17

text.en: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:18

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:19

text.en: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:20

text.en: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”

title.en: The Good News According to John 21:21

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:21

title.en: The Good News According to John 21:22

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:22

text.en: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”

title.en: The Good News According to John 21:23

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:23

text.en: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”

title.en: The Good News According to John 21:24

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:24

text.en: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.

summary.en: The Good News According to John 21:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to John 21:25

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:1

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:2

text.en: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:3

text.en: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:4

text.en: Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:5

text.en: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:6

text.en: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority and their glory, for it has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I want.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:7

text.en: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:8

text.en: Jesus answered him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:9

text.en: He led him to Jerusalem and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:10

text.en: for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:11

text.en: and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:12

text.en: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:13

text.en: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:14

text.en: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:15

text.en: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:16

text.en: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:17

text.en: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:18

text.en: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:19

text.en: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:20

text.en: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:21

text.en: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:22

text.en: All testified about him and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth; and they said, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:23

text.en: He said to them, “Doubtless you will tell me this proverb, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.’”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:24

text.en: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:25

text.en: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:26

text.en: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:27

text.en: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:28

text.en: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue as they heard these things.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:29

text.en: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:30

text.en: But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:37

text.en: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:38

text.en: He rose up from the synagogue and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him to help her.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:39

text.en: He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:40

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:40

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:40

text.en: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:41

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:41

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:41

text.en: Demons also came out of many, crying out and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:42

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:42

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:42

text.en: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:43

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:43

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:43

text.en: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:44

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:44

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 4:44

text.en: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:12

text.en: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:13

text.en: He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:14

text.en: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:15

text.en: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:16

text.en: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:27

text.en: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:28

text.en: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:29

text.en: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:30

text.en: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:31

text.en: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:32

text.en: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:33

text.en: They said to him, “Why do John’s disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:34

text.en: He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:35

text.en: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:36

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:36

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:36

text.en: He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:37

text.en: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:38

text.en: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 5:39

text.en: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:1

text.en: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:2

text.en: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:3

text.en: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:4

text.en: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:5

text.en: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:6

text.en: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:7

text.en: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:8

text.en: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:9

text.en: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:10

text.en: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:12

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:13

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:14

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:15

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:16

text.en: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:17

text.en: He came down with them and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:18

text.en: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits; and they were being healed.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:19

text.en: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:20

text.en: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:21

text.en: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:22

text.en: Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:23

text.en: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:24

text.en: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:25

text.en: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:26

text.en: Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:27

text.en: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:28

text.en: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:29

text.en: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:30

text.en: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:37

text.en: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:38

text.en: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:39

text.en: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:40

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:40

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:40

text.en: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:41

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:41

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:41

text.en: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:42

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:42

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:42

text.en: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:43

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:43

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:43

text.en: “For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit, nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:44

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:44

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:44

text.en: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:45

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:45

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:45

text.en: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:46

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:46

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:46

text.en: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:47

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:47

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:47

text.en: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them, I will show you who he is like.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:48

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:48

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:48

text.en: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:49

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:49

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 6:49

text.en: But he who hears and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:1

text.en: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:2

text.en: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:3

text.en: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:4

text.en: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:5

text.en: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:6

text.en: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:7

text.en: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:8

text.en: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:9

text.en: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:10

text.en: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:11

text.en: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:12

text.en: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only born son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:13

text.en: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, “Don’t cry.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:14

text.en: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:15

text.en: He who was dead sat up and began to speak. Then he gave him to his mother.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:16

text.en: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:17

text.en: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:18

text.en: The disciples of John told him about all these things.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:19

text.en: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:20

text.en: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:21

text.en: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:22

text.en: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:23

text.en: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:24

text.en: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:25

text.en: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed and live delicately are in kings’ courts.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:26

text.en: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:27

text.en: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:28

text.en: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:29

text.en: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:30

text.en: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:36

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:36

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:36

text.en: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house and sat at the table.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:37

text.en: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:38

text.en: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:39

text.en: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:40

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:40

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:40

text.en: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:41

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:41

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:41

text.en: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:42

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:42

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:42

text.en: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:43

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:43

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:43

text.en: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:44

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:44

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:44

text.en: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:45

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:45

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:45

text.en: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:46

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:46

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:46

text.en: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:47

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:47

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:47

text.en: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:48

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:48

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:48

text.en: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:49

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:49

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:49

text.en: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:50

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:50

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 7:50

text.en: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:1

text.en: Soon afterwards, he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God’s Kingdom. With him were the twelve,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:2

text.en: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:3

text.en: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward; Susanna; and many others who served them from their possessions.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:5

text.en: “The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:6

text.en: Some seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:7

text.en: Some fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it and choked it.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:8

text.en: Some fell into the good ground and grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit.” As he said these things, he called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:9

text.en: Then his disciples asked him, “What does this parable mean?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:10

text.en: He said, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God’s Kingdom, but to the rest it is given in parables, that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:11

text.en: “Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:12

text.en: Those along the road are those who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:13

text.en: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root. They believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:14

text.en: What fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life; and they bring no fruit to maturity.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:15

text.en: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:16

text.en: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:17

text.en: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed, nor anything secret that will not be known and come to light.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:18

text.en: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:19

text.en: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:20

text.en: Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:21

text.en: But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:26

text.en: Then they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:27

text.en: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn’t live in a house, but in the tombs.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:28

text.en: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, “What do I have to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don’t torment me!”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:29

text.en: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard and bound with chains and fetters. Breaking the bonds apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:30

text.en: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:31

text.en: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:32

text.en: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those. Then he allowed them.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:33

text.en: The demons came out of the man and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:34

text.en: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:35

text.en: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:36

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:36

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:36

text.en: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:37

text.en: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. Then he entered into the boat and returned.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:38

text.en: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:39

text.en: “Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you.” He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:41

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:41

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:41

text.en: Behold, a man named Jairus came. He was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus’ feet and begged him to come into his house,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:42

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:42

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:42

text.en: for he had an only born daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:43

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:43

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:43

text.en: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by any,
