title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:44

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:44

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:44

text.en: came behind him and touched the fringe of his cloak. Immediately the flow of her blood stopped.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:45

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:45

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:45

text.en: Jesus said, “Who touched me?” When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, “Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:46

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:46

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:46

text.en: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:47

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:47

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:47

text.en: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:48

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:48

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:48

text.en: He said to her, “Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:49

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:49

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:49

text.en: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house came, saying to him, “Your daughter is dead. Don’t trouble the Teacher.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:50

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:50

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:50

text.en: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, “Don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:51

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:51

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:51

text.en: When he came to the house, he didn’t allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:52

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:52

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:52

text.en: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, “Don’t weep. She isn’t dead, but sleeping.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:53

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:53

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:53

text.en: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:54

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:54

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:54

text.en: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, “Child, arise!”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:55

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:55

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:55

text.en: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:56

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:56

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 8:56

text.en: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:1

text.en: He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:2

text.en: He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:3

text.en: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two tunics each.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:4

text.en: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:5

text.en: As many as don’t receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:6

text.en: They departed and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News and healing everywhere.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:7

text.en: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:8

text.en: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:9

text.en: Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:10

text.en: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert region of a city called Bethsaida.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:11

text.en: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them of God’s Kingdom, and he cured those who needed healing.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:12

text.en: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came and said to him, “Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms and lodge and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:13

text.en: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:14

text.en: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:15

text.en: They did so, and made them all sit down.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:16

text.en: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:17

text.en: They ate and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:18

text.en: As he was praying alone, the disciples were near him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:19

text.en: They answered, “‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets has risen again.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:20

text.en: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:21

text.en: But he warned them and commanded them to tell this to no one,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:22

text.en: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:23

text.en: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:24

text.en: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake will save it.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:25

text.en: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:26

text.en: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:27

text.en: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God’s Kingdom.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:37

text.en: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:38

text.en: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only born child.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:39

text.en: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams; and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:40

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:40

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:40

text.en: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:41

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:41

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:41

text.en: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:42

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:42

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:42

text.en: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:43

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:43

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:43

text.en: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:44

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:44

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:44

text.en: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:45

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:45

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:45

text.en: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:46

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:46

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:46

text.en: An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:47

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:47

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:47

text.en: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:48

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:48

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:48

text.en: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:49

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:49

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:49

text.en: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:50

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:50

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:50

text.en: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:51

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:51

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:51

text.en: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:52

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:52

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:52

text.en: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:53

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:53

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:53

text.en: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:54

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:54

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:54

text.en: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:55

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:55

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:55

text.en: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:56

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:56

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:56

text.en: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:57

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:57

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:57

text.en: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:58

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:58

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:58

text.en: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:59

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:59

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:59

text.en: He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:60

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:60

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:60

text.en: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:61

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:61

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:61

text.en: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:62

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:62

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 9:62

text.en: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:1

text.en: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:2

text.en: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:3

text.en: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:4

text.en: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:5

text.en: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:6

text.en: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:7

text.en: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:8

text.en: Into whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:9

text.en: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:10

text.en: But into whatever city you enter and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:11

text.en: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:12

text.en: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:13

text.en: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:14

text.en: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:15

text.en: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:19

text.en: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:20

text.en: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:21

text.en: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:22

text.en: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:23

text.en: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:24

text.en: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:25

text.en: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:26

text.en: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:27

text.en: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:28

text.en: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:29

text.en: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:30

text.en: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:31

text.en: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:32

text.en: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:33

text.en: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:34

text.en: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:35

text.en: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:36

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:36

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:36

text.en: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:37

text.en: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:38

text.en: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:39

text.en: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:40

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:40

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:40

text.en: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:41

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:41

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:41

text.en: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:42

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:42

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 10:42

text.en: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:1

text.en: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:2

text.en: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:3

text.en: Give us day by day our daily bread.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:4

text.en: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:5

text.en: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:6

text.en: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:7

text.en: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:8

text.en: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:9

text.en: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:10

text.en: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:11

text.en: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:12

text.en: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:13

text.en: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:14

text.en: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:15

text.en: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:16

text.en: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:17

text.en: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:18

text.en: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:19

text.en: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:20

text.en: But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:21

text.en: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:22

text.en: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:23

text.en: “He who is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:24

text.en: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:25

text.en: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:26

text.en: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:27

text.en: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:28

text.en: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:29

text.en: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:30

text.en: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:31

text.en: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:32

text.en: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:33

text.en: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:34

text.en: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:35

text.en: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:36

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:36

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:36

text.en: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:37

text.en: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in and sat at the table.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:38

text.en: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:39

text.en: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:40

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:40

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:40

text.en: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:41

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:41

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:41

text.en: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:42

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:42

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:42

text.en: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:43

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:43

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:43

text.en: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:44

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:44

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:44

text.en: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:45

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:45

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:45

text.en: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:46

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:46

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:46

text.en: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:47

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:47

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:47

text.en: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:48

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:48

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:48

text.en: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:49

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:49

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:49

text.en: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:50

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:50

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:50

text.en: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:51

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:51

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:51

text.en: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:52

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:52

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:52

text.en: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:53

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:53

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:53

text.en: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:54

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:54

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 11:54

text.en: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:1

text.en: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:2

text.en: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed, nor hidden that will not be known.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:3

text.en: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:4

text.en: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:5

text.en: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:6

text.en: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins ? Not one of them is forgotten by God.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:7

text.en: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:8

text.en: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God;

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:9

text.en: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God’s angels.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:10

text.en: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:11

text.en: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer or what you will say;

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:12

text.en: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:13

text.en: One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:14

text.en: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:15

text.en: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:16

text.en: He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:17

text.en: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:18

text.en: He said, ‘This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:19

text.en: I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.”’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:20

text.en: “But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose will they be?’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:21

text.en: So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:22

text.en: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:23

text.en: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:24

text.en: Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:25

text.en: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:26

text.en: If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:27

text.en: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:28

text.en: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:29

text.en: “Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:30

text.en: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:31

text.en: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:32

text.en: “Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:33

text.en: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:34

text.en: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:35

text.en: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:36

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:36

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:36

text.en: Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast, that when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:37

text.en: Blessed are those servants whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will dress himself, make them recline, and will come and serve them.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:38

text.en: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch and finds them so.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:39

text.en: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:40

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:40

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:40

text.en: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:42

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:42

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:42

text.en: The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:43

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:43

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:43

text.en: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:44

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:44

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:44

text.en: Truly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:45

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:45

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:45

text.en: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink and to be drunken,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:46

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:46

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:46

text.en: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:47

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:47

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:47

text.en: That servant who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:48

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:48

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:48

text.en: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:49

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:49

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:49

text.en: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:50

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:50

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:50

text.en: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:51

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:51

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:51

text.en: Do you think that I have come to give peace on the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:52

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:52

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:52

text.en: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:53

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:53

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:53

text.en: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:54

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:54

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:54

text.en: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:55

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:55

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:55

text.en: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:56

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:56

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:56

text.en: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:57

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:57

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:57

text.en: “Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:58

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:58

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:58

text.en: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:59

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:59

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 12:59

text.en: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there until you have paid the very last penny. ”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:1

text.en: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:2

text.en: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:3

text.en: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:4

text.en: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them—do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:5

text.en: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:6

text.en: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:7

text.en: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down! Why does it waste the soil?’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:8

text.en: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:9

text.en: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:10

text.en: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:11

text.en: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:12

text.en: When Jesus saw her, he called her and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:13

text.en: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:14

text.en: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:15

text.en: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:16

text.en: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:17

text.en: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:18

text.en: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:19

text.en: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden. It grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:20

text.en: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:21

text.en: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:22

text.en: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:23

text.en: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:24

text.en: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:25

text.en: When once the master of the house has risen up and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:26

text.en: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:27

text.en: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:28

text.en: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:29

text.en: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:31

text.en: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:32

text.en: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:33

text.en: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:34

text.en: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 13:35

text.en: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:1

text.en: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:2

text.en: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:3

text.en: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:4

text.en: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:5

text.en: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:6

text.en: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:7

text.en: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:8

text.en: “When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:9

text.en: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:10

text.en: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:11

text.en: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:12

text.en: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:13

text.en: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:14

text.en: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:15

text.en: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:16

text.en: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:17

text.en: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:18

text.en: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:19

text.en: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:20

text.en: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:21

text.en: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:22

text.en: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:23

text.en: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:24

text.en: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper. For many are called, but few are chosen. ’”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:25

text.en: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:26

text.en: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:27

text.en: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross and come after me, can’t be my disciple.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:28

text.en: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:29

text.en: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation and isn’t able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:30

text.en: saying, ‘This man began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:31

text.en: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:32

text.en: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy and asks for conditions of peace.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:33

text.en: So therefore, whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:34

text.en: “Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 14:35

text.en: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:1

text.en: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:2
