text.en: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:3

text.en: He told them this parable:

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:4

text.en: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:5

text.en: When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:6

text.en: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:7

text.en: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:8

text.en: “Or what woman, if she had ten drachma coins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:9

text.en: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost!’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 15:10

text.en: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:1

text.en: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:2

text.en: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:3

text.en: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:4

text.en: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:5

text.en: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:6

text.en: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:7

text.en: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:8

text.en: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:9

text.en: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:15

text.en: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:16

text.en: “The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God’s Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:17

text.en: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:18

text.en: “Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:19

text.en: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:20

text.en: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:21

text.en: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:22

text.en: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died and was buried.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:23

text.en: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:24

text.en: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:25

text.en: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted and you are in anguish.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:26

text.en: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:27

text.en: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house—

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:28

text.en: for I have five brothers—that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:29

text.en: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:30

text.en: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 16:31

text.en: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:1

text.en: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:2

text.en: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:3

text.en: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:4

text.en: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:12

text.en: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:13

text.en: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:14

text.en: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:15

text.en: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:16

text.en: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:17

text.en: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:18

text.en: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:19

text.en: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:20

text.en: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:21

text.en: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:22

text.en: He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:23

text.en: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:24

text.en: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of one part under the sky, shines to another part under the sky, so will the Son of Man be in his day.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:25

text.en: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:26

text.en: As it was in the days of Noah, even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:27

text.en: They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:28

text.en: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:29

text.en: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:30

text.en: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:31

text.en: In that day, he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:32

text.en: Remember Lot’s wife!

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:33

text.en: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:34

text.en: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:35

text.en: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 17:37

text.en: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be gathered together.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:15

text.en: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:16

text.en: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:17

text.en: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:26

text.en: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:27

text.en: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:28

text.en: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:29

text.en: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:30

text.en: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:31

text.en: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:32

text.en: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:33

text.en: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 18:34

text.en: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:12

text.en: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:13

text.en: He called ten servants of his and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:14

text.en: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:15

text.en: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:16

text.en: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:17

text.en: “He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:18

text.en: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:19

text.en: “So he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:20

text.en: Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:21

text.en: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:22

text.en: “He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’t lay down and reaping that which I didn’t sow.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:23

text.en: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:24

text.en: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:25

text.en: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:26

text.en: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:27

text.en: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:28

text.en: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:37

text.en: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:38

text.en: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:39

text.en: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:40

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:40

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:40

text.en: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:41

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:41

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:41

text.en: When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:42

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:42

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:42

text.en: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:43

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:43

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:43

text.en: For the days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:44

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:44

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:44

text.en: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:45

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:45

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:45

text.en: He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:46

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:46

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:46

text.en: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:47

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:47

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:47

text.en: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:48

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:48

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 19:48

text.en: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:1

text.en: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:2

text.en: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:3

text.en: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:4

text.en: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:5

text.en: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:6

text.en: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:7

text.en: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:8

text.en: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:9

text.en: He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:10

text.en: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:11

text.en: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:12

text.en: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him and threw him out.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:13

text.en: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:14

text.en: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:15

text.en: Then they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:16

text.en: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard that, they said, “May that never be!”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:17

text.en: But he looked at them and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone’?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:18

text.en: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:27

text.en: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:28

text.en: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife and raise up children for his brother.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:29

text.en: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:30

text.en: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:31

text.en: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:32

text.en: Afterward the woman also died.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:33

text.en: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:34

text.en: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:35

text.en: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:36

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:36

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:36

text.en: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:37

text.en: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:38

text.en: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:39

text.en: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:40

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:40

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:40

text.en: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:41

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:41

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:41

text.en: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:42

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:42

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:42

text.en: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:43

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:43

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:43

text.en: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:44

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:44

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 20:44

text.en: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:5

text.en: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:6

text.en: “As for these things which you see, the days will come in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:7

text.en: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:10

text.en: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:11

text.en: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:12

text.en: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:13

text.en: It will turn out as a testimony for you.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:14

text.en: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:15

text.en: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:16

text.en: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:17

text.en: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:18

text.en: And not a hair of your head will perish.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:19

text.en: “By your endurance you will win your lives.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:20

text.en: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:21

text.en: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:22

text.en: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:23

text.en: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:24

text.en: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:28

text.en: But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:29

text.en: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:30

text.en: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:31

text.en: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:32

text.en: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:33

text.en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:37

text.en: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 21:38

text.en: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:1

text.en: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:2

text.en: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:3

text.en: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:4

text.en: He went away and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:5

text.en: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:6

text.en: He consented and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:7

text.en: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 22:8

text.en: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:1

text.en: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:2

text.en: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:3

text.en: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:4

text.en: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:5

text.en: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. The men said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:6

text.en: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:7

text.en: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:8

text.en: They remembered his words,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:9

text.en: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:10

text.en: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:11

text.en: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:12

text.en: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:13

text.en: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:14

text.en: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:15

text.en: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:16

text.en: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:17

text.en: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:18

text.en: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:19

text.en: He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:20

text.en: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:21

text.en: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:22

text.en: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:23

text.en: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:24

text.en: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:25

text.en: He said to them, “Foolish people, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:26

text.en: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:27

text.en: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:28

text.en: They came near to the village where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:29

text.en: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:30

text.en: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave it to them.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:31

text.en: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:32

text.en: They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:33

text.en: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:34

text.en: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:35

text.en: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:36

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:36

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:36

text.en: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:37

text.en: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:38

text.en: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:39

text.en: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”

title.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:40

summary.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:40

speaker.en: The Good News According to Luke 24:40

text.en: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
