summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:12

text.en: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:13

text.en: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:14

text.en: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:15

text.en: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:16

text.en: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:17

text.en: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:18

text.en: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:19

text.en: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:20

text.en: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:21

text.en: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:22

text.en: But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:23

text.en: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:24

text.en: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:25

text.en: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 19:26

text.en: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:1

text.en: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:2

text.en: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:3

text.en: He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:4

text.en: He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:5

text.en: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:6

text.en: About the eleventh hour he went out and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:7

text.en: “They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:8

text.en: “When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:9

text.en: “When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:10

text.en: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:11

text.en: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:12

text.en: saying, ‘These last have spent one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:13

text.en: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’t you agree with me for a denarius?

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:14

text.en: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:15

text.en: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:16

text.en: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:17

text.en: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:18

text.en: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:19

text.en: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:20

text.en: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:21

text.en: He said to her, “What do you want?” She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:22

text.en: But Jesus answered, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?” They said to him, “We are able.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:23

text.en: He said to them, “You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with; but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give, but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:24

text.en: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:25

text.en: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:26

text.en: It shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:27

text.en: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:28

text.en: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:29

text.en: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:30

text.en: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:31

text.en: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:32

text.en: Jesus stood still and called them, and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:33

text.en: They told him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 20:34

text.en: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:12

text.en: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:13

text.en: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a den of robbers!”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:14

text.en: The lame and the blind came to him in the temple, and he healed them.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:17

text.en: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:18

text.en: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:19

text.en: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!” Immediately the fig tree withered away.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:20

text.en: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:21

text.en: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:22

text.en: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:23

text.en: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:24

text.en: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:25

text.en: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:26

text.en: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:27

text.en: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:28

text.en: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:29

text.en: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:30

text.en: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:31

text.en: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God’s Kingdom before you.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:32

text.en: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:33

text.en: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:34

text.en: When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers to receive his fruit.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:35

text.en: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:36

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:36

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:36

text.en: Again, he sent other servants more than the first; and they treated them the same way.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:37

text.en: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:38

text.en: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and seize his inheritance.’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:39

text.en: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, then killed him.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:40

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:40

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:40

text.en: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:41

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:41

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:41

text.en: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit in its season.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:42

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:42

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:42

text.en: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:43

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:43

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:43

text.en: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:44

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:44

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:44

text.en: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:45

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:45

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:45

text.en: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:46

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:46

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 21:46

text.en: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:1

text.en: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:2

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:3

text.en: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:4

text.en: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the wedding feast!”’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:5

text.en: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:6

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:7

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:8

text.en: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:9

text.en: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:10

text.en: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:11

text.en: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:12

text.en: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:13

text.en: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:14

text.en: For many are called, but few chosen.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:15

text.en: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:16

text.en: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach; for you aren’t partial to anyone.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:18

text.en: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:19

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:20

text.en: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:21

text.en: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:22

text.en: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him and went away.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:23

text.en: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:24

text.en: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:25

text.en: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:26

text.en: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:27

text.en: After them all, the woman died.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:28

text.en: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:29

text.en: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:30

text.en: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:31

text.en: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:32

text.en: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:33

text.en: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:35

text.en: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:36

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:36

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:36

text.en: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:37

text.en: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:38

text.en: This is the first and great commandment.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:39

text.en: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:40

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:40

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:40

text.en: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:41

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:41

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:41

text.en: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:42

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:42

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:42

text.en: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:43

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:43

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:43

text.en: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:44

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:44

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:44

text.en: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet’?

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:45

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:45

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:45

text.en: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:46

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:46

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 22:46

text.en: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:1

text.en: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:2

text.en: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:3

text.en: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:4

text.en: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:5

text.en: But they do all their works to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the fringes of their garments,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:6

text.en: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:7

text.en: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:8

text.en: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi’, for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:9

text.en: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:10

text.en: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:11

text.en: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:12

text.en: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:13

text.en: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:14

text.en: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:15

text.en: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:16

text.en: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:17

text.en: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:18

text.en: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated.’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:19

text.en: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:20

text.en: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:21

text.en: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living in it.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:22

text.en: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:23

text.en: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:24

text.en: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:25

text.en: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:26

text.en: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:27

text.en: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:28

text.en: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:29

text.en: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:30

text.en: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:31

text.en: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:32

text.en: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:33

text.en: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:34

text.en: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:35

text.en: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:36

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:36

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:36

text.en: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:37

text.en: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:38

text.en: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 23:39

text.en: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:1

text.en: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:2

text.en: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:3

text.en: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:4

text.en: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:5

text.en: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:6

text.en: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:7

text.en: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:8

text.en: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:9

text.en: “Then they will deliver you up to oppression and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:10

text.en: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:11

text.en: Many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:12

text.en: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:13

text.en: But he who endures to the end will be saved.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:14

text.en: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:15

text.en: “When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:16

text.en: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:17

text.en: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:18

text.en: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:19

text.en: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:20

text.en: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter nor on a Sabbath,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:21

text.en: for then there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:22

text.en: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:23

text.en: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘There!’ don’t believe it.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:24

text.en: For false christs and false prophets will arise, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:25

text.en: “Behold, I have told you beforehand.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:26

text.en: “If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; or ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:27

text.en: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:28

text.en: For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:29

text.en: “But immediately after the suffering of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:30

text.en: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:31

text.en: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:32

text.en: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable: When its branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:33

text.en: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that he is near, even at the doors.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:34

text.en: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things are accomplished.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:35

text.en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:36

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:36

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:36

text.en: “But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:37

text.en: As the days of Noah were, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:38

text.en: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:39

text.en: and they didn’t know until the flood came and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:40

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:40

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:40

text.en: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:41

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:41

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:41

text.en: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:42

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:42

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:42

text.en: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:43

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:43

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:43

text.en: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:44

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:44

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:44

text.en: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:45

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:45

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:45

text.en: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:46

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:46

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:46

text.en: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:47

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:47

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:47

text.en: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:48

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:48

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:48

text.en: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:49

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:49

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:49

text.en: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:50

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:50

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:50

text.en: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:51

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:51

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 24:51

text.en: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 28:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 28:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 28:16

text.en: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 28:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 28:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 28:17

text.en: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 28:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 28:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 28:18

text.en: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 28:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 28:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 28:19

text.en: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

title.en: The Good News According to Matthew 28:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Matthew 28:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Matthew 28:20

text.en: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:9

text.en: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:10

text.en: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:11

text.en: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:12

text.en: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:13

text.en: He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:14

text.en: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:15

text.en: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:16

text.en: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:17

text.en: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:18

text.en: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:19

text.en: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:20

text.en: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:21

text.en: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:22

text.en: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:29

text.en: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:30

text.en: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:31

text.en: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:32

text.en: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:33

text.en: All the city was gathered together at the door.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:34

text.en: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 1:35

text.en: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 2:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 2:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 2:18

text.en: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 2:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 2:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 2:19

text.en: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 2:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 2:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 2:20

text.en: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 2:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 2:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 2:21

text.en: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 2:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 2:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 2:22

text.en: No one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:6

text.en: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:7

text.en: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:8

text.en: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:9

text.en: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:10

text.en: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:11

text.en: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him and cried, “You are the Son of God!”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:12

text.en: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:13

text.en: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:14

text.en: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:15

text.en: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:16

text.en: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:17

text.en: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:18

text.en: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:19

text.en: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:20

text.en: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:21

text.en: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:22

text.en: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:23

text.en: He summoned them and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:24

text.en: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:25

text.en: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:26

text.en: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:27

text.en: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:28

text.en: “Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:29

text.en: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:30

text.en: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:31

text.en: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:32

text.en: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:33

text.en: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:34

text.en: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 3:35

text.en: For whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:10

text.en: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:11

text.en: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:12

text.en: that ‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:13

text.en: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:14

text.en: The farmer sows the word.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:15

text.en: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:16

text.en: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:17

text.en: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:18

text.en: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:19

text.en: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:20

text.en: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:21

text.en: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:22

text.en: For there is nothing hidden except that it should be made known, neither was anything made secret but that it should come to light.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:23

text.en: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:24
