speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:24

text.en: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:25

text.en: For whoever has, to him more will be given; and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:26

text.en: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:27

text.en: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:28

text.en: For the earth bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:29

text.en: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:30

text.en: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:31

text.en: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:32

text.en: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:33

text.en: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:34

text.en: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:35

text.en: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:36

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:36

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:36

text.en: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:37

text.en: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:38

text.en: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:39

text.en: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:40

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:40

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:40

text.en: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:41

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:41

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 4:41

text.en: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:1

text.en: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:2

text.en: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:3

text.en: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:4

text.en: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:5

text.en: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:6

text.en: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:7

text.en: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:8

text.en: For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:9

text.en: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:10

text.en: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:11

text.en: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:12

text.en: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:13

text.en: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:14

text.en: Those who fed the pigs fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:15

text.en: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:16

text.en: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:17

text.en: They began to beg him to depart from their region.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:18

text.en: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:19

text.en: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:20

text.en: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:22

text.en: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:23

text.en: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:24

text.en: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:25

text.en: A certain woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:26

text.en: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:27

text.en: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:28

text.en: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:29

text.en: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:30

text.en: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:31

text.en: His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:32

text.en: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:33

text.en: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:34

text.en: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:35

text.en: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house, saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:36

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:36

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:36

text.en: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:37

text.en: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:38

text.en: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:39

text.en: When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:40

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:40

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:40

text.en: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:41

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:41

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:41

text.en: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get up!”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:42

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:42

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:42

text.en: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:43

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:43

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 5:43

text.en: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:1

text.en: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:2

text.en: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:3

text.en: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” So they were offended at him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:4

text.en: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:5

text.en: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:6

text.en: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:7

text.en: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:8

text.en: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:9

text.en: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:10

text.en: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:11

text.en: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:12

text.en: They went out and preached that people should repent.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:13

text.en: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:14

text.en: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:15

text.en: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:16

text.en: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:17

text.en: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:18

text.en: For John had said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:19

text.en: Herodias set herself against him and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:20

text.en: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:21

text.en: Then a convenient day came when Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:22

text.en: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:23

text.en: He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:24

text.en: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:25

text.en: She came in immediately with haste to the king and requested, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:26

text.en: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:27

text.en: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard and commanded to bring John’s head; and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:28

text.en: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:29

text.en: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:30

text.en: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:31

text.en: He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:32

text.en: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:33

text.en: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:34

text.en: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:35

text.en: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:36

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:36

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:36

text.en: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:37

text.en: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:38

text.en: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:39

text.en: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:40

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:40

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:40

text.en: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:41

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:41

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:41

text.en: He took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:42

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:42

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:42

text.en: They all ate and were filled.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:43

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:43

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:43

text.en: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:44

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:44

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:44

text.en: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:45

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:45

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:45

text.en: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:54

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:54

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:54

text.en: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:55

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:55

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:55

text.en: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:56

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:56

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 6:56

text.en: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:1

text.en: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:2

text.en: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:3

text.en: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:4

text.en: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:5

text.en: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:6

text.en: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:7

text.en: They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:8

text.en: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:9

text.en: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:10

text.en: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:11

text.en: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban,”’” that is to say, given to God,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:12

text.en: “then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:13

text.en: making void the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:14

text.en: He called all the multitude to himself and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:15

text.en: There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:16

text.en: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:17

text.en: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:18

text.en: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:19

text.en: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, making all foods clean?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:20

text.en: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:21

text.en: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:22

text.en: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:23

text.en: All these evil things come from within and defile the man.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:24

text.en: From there he arose and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:25

text.en: For a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:26

text.en: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:27

text.en: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:28

text.en: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:29

text.en: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 7:30

text.en: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:1

text.en: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:2

text.en: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:3

text.en: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:4

text.en: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:5

text.en: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:6

text.en: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:7

text.en: They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:8

text.en: They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:9

text.en: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:10

text.en: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:11

text.en: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:12

text.en: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:13

text.en: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:14

text.en: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:15

text.en: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:16

text.en: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:17

text.en: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet or understand? Is your heart still hardened?

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:18

text.en: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:19

text.en: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:20

text.en: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:21

text.en: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:22

text.en: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:23

text.en: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:24

text.en: He looked up, and said, “I see men, but I see them like walking trees.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:25

text.en: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:26

text.en: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:30

text.en: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:31

text.en: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:32

text.en: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:33

text.en: But he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:34

text.en: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:35

text.en: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:36

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:36

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:36

text.en: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:37

text.en: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 8:38

text.en: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:1

text.en: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God’s Kingdom come with power.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:10

text.en: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:11

text.en: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:12

text.en: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:13

text.en: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:14

text.en: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:15

text.en: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:16

text.en: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:33

text.en: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:34

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:34

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:34

text.en: But they were silent, for they had disputed with one another on the way about who was the greatest.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:35

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:35

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:35

text.en: He sat down and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:36

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:36

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:36

text.en: He took a little child and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:37

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:37

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:37

text.en: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me; and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:38

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:38

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:38

text.en: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:39

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:39

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:39

text.en: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:40

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:40

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:40

text.en: For whoever is not against us is on our side.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:41

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:41

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:41

text.en: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:42

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:42

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:42

text.en: “Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:43

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:43

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:43

text.en: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:44

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:44

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:44

text.en: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:45

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:45

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:45

text.en: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:46

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:46

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:46

text.en: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:47

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:47

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:47

text.en: If your eye causes you to stumble, throw it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:48

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:48

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:48

text.en: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:49

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:49

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:49

text.en: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:50

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:50

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 9:50

text.en: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:1

text.en: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:2

text.en: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:3

text.en: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:4

text.en: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:5

text.en: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:6

text.en: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:7

text.en: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:8

text.en: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:9

text.en: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:10

text.en: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:11

text.en: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:12

text.en: If a woman herself divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:13

text.en: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:14

text.en: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:15

text.en: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:16

text.en: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:17

text.en: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:18

text.en: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:19

text.en: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not give false testimony,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and mother.’”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:20

text.en: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:21

text.en: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:22

text.en: But his face fell at that saying, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:23

text.en: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:24

text.en: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, “Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:25

text.en: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:26

text.en: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:27

text.en: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:46

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:46

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:46

text.en: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:47

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:47

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:47

text.en: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:48

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:48

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:48

text.en: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:49

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:49

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:49

text.en: Jesus stood still and said, “Call him.” They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:50

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:50

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:50

text.en: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:51

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:51

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:51

text.en: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:52

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:52

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 10:52

text.en: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the way.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:11

text.en: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:12

text.en: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:13

text.en: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:14

text.en: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:15

text.en: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:16

text.en: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:17

text.en: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers!”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:18

text.en: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:19

text.en: When evening came, he went out of the city.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:20

text.en: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:21

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:21

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:21

text.en: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:22

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:22

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:22

text.en: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:23

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:23

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:23

text.en: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:24

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:24

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:24

text.en: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:25

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:25

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:25

text.en: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:26

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:26

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:26

text.en: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:27

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:27

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:27

text.en: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:28

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:28

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:28

text.en: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:29

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:29

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:29

text.en: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:30

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:30

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:30

text.en: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:31

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:31

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:31

text.en: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:32

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:32

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:32

text.en: If we should say, ‘From men’”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:33

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:33

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 11:33

text.en: They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:1

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:1

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:1

text.en: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:2

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:2

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:2

text.en: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:3

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:3

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:3

text.en: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:4

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:4

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:4

text.en: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:5

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:5

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:5

text.en: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:6

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:6

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:6

text.en: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:7

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:7

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:7

text.en: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:8

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:8

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:8

text.en: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:9

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:9

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:9

text.en: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:10

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:10

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:10

text.en: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:11

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:11

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:11

text.en: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:12

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:12

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:12

text.en: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:13

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:13

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:13

text.en: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:14

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:14

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:14

text.en: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:15

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:15

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:15

text.en: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:16

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:16

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:16

text.en: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:17

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:17

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:17

text.en: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:18

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:18

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:18

text.en: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:19

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:19

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:19

text.en: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.

title.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:20

summary.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:20

speaker.en: The Good News According to Mark 16:20

text.en: They went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:1

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:1

text.en: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:2

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:2

text.en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:3

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:3

text.en: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:4

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:4

text.en: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:5

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:5

text.en: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:6

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:6

text.en: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:7

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:7

text.en: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:8

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:8

text.en: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:9

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:9

text.en: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:10

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:10

text.en: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:11

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:11

text.en: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:12

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:12

text.en: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:13

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:13

text.en: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:14

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:14

text.en: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:15

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:15

text.en: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:16

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:16

text.en: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:17

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:17

text.en: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:18

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:18

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:18

text.en: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:19

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:19

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:19

text.en: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:20

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:20

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:20
