text.en: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:21

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:21

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:21

text.en: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:22

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:22

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:22

text.en: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:23

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:23

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:23

text.en: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:24

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:24

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:24

text.en: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:25

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:25

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:25

text.en: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:26

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:26

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:26

text.en: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:27

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:27

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 1:27

text.en: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:5

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:5

text.en: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:6

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:6

text.en: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:7

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:7

text.en: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:8

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:8

text.en: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:9

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:9

text.en: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:10

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:10

text.en: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:11

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:11

text.en: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:12

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:12

text.en: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:13

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:13

text.en: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:14

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:14

text.en: Do all things without complaining and arguing,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:15

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:15

text.en: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:16

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:16

text.en: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:17

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:17

text.en: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:18

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:18

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:18

text.en: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:19

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:19

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:19

text.en: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:20

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:20

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:20

text.en: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:21

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:21

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:21

text.en: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:22

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:22

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:22

text.en: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:23

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:23

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 2:23

text.en: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:1

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:1

text.en: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:2

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:2

text.en: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:3

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:3

text.en: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:4

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:4

text.en: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:5

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:5

text.en: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:6

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:6

text.en: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:7

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:7

text.en: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:8

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:8

text.en: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:9

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:9

text.en: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:10

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:10

text.en: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:11

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:11

text.en: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:12

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:12

text.en: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:13

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:13

text.en: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:14

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:14

text.en: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:15

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:15

text.en: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:16

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:16

text.en: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:17

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:17

text.en: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:18

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:18

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:18

text.en: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:19

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:19

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 3:19

text.en: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:10

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:10

text.en: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:11

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:11

text.en: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:12

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:12

text.en: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:13

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:13

text.en: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:14

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:14

text.en: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:15

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:15

text.en: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:16

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:16

text.en: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:17

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:17

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:17

text.en: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:18

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:18

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:18

text.en: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:19

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:19

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:19

text.en: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:20

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:20

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:20

text.en: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:21

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:21

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:21

text.en: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:22

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:22

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:22

text.en: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:23

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:23

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Philippians 4:23

text.en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 14:6

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 14:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 14:6

text.en: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 14:7

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 14:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 14:7

text.en: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 14:8

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 14:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 14:8

text.en: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 14:9

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 14:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 14:9

text.en: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 15:30

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 15:30

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 15:30

text.en: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 15:31

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 15:31

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 15:31

text.en: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 15:32

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 15:32

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 15:32

text.en: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 15:33

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 15:33

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to the Romans 15:33

text.en: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:5

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:5

text.en: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:6

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:6

text.en: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:7

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:7

text.en: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:8

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:8

text.en: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:9

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:9

text.en: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:10

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:10

text.en: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:11

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:11

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:11

text.en: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:12

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:12

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:12

text.en: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:13

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:13

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:13

text.en: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:14

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:14

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:14

text.en: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:15

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:15

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:15

text.en: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:16

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:16

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 1:16

text.en: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:1

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:1

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:1

text.en: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:2

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:2

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:2

text.en: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:3

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:3

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:3

text.en: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:4

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:4

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:4

text.en: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:5

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:5

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:5

text.en: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:6

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:6

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:6

text.en: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:7

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:7

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:7

text.en: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:8

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:8

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:8

text.en: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:9

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:9

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:9

text.en: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,

title.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:10

summary.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:10

speaker.en: Paul’s Letter to Titus 2:10

text.en: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.
